components.name: openmrs
components.why: pom.xml:18-20 declares groupId org.openmrs, artifactId openmrs, version 3.0.0-SNAPSHOT with packaging pom; it is the multi-module root aggregator declaring 8 child modules.

components.name: openmrs-api
components.why: api/pom.xml:21-22 declares groupId org.openmrs.api, artifactId openmrs-api; packaging defaults to jar; parent is org.openmrs:openmrs (lines 15-17).

components.name: openmrs-webapp
components.why: webapp/pom.xml:20-21 declares artifactId openmrs-webapp with packaging war; finalName is ${webapp.name} which resolves to 'openmrs' (line 207 of webapp/pom.xml); parent is org.openmrs:openmrs.

deployables.name: openmrs-core
deployables.why: Dockerfile at repository root defines a multi-stage Maven + Tomcat container build; the runtime stage (line 125: FROM tomcat:11-$RUNTIME_JDK) copies the built WAR into Tomcat and exposes port 8080.

deployables.name: db
deployables.why: docker-compose.yml defines a service named 'db' using image mariadb:10.11.7 with no local build context; it is a Compose service providing the relational datastore.

deployables.name: api
deployables.why: docker-compose.yml defines a service named 'api' with build context '.' (the repository root), ports 8080:8080, and depends_on 'db'; it runs the openmrs application container.

interfaces.why: Dockerfile line 170: EXPOSE 8080 in the production runtime stage (FROM tomcat:11-$RUNTIME_JDK); the dev stage at line 113 also declares EXPOSE 8080.
docker-compose.yml: the 'api' service declares ports: '8080:8080', publishing the container's port 8080 to the host.

capabilities.why: api/pom.xml lines 213-215: runtime dependency com.mysql:mysql-connector-j (the official MySQL JDBC connector); lines 218-220 also declare org.mariadb.jdbc:mariadb-java-client (MariaDB, MySQL-protocol-compatible) as a runtime dependency.
api/pom.xml lines 222-224: runtime dependency org.postgresql:postgresql (the official PostgreSQL JDBC driver).
api/pom.xml line 156: dependency org.hibernate.search:hibernate-search-backend-elasticsearch declares Hibernate Search's Elasticsearch backend, establishing an Elasticsearch datastore capability.

edges.why: api/pom.xml lines 15-17 declare parent org.openmrs:openmrs; root pom.xml line 57 lists <module>api</module>, establishing api as a member of the root aggregator.
webapp/pom.xml lines 14-17 declare parent org.openmrs:openmrs; root pom.xml line 59 lists <module>webapp</module>, establishing webapp as a member of the root aggregator.
webapp/pom.xml line 28: dependency on org.openmrs.api:openmrs-api (a sibling Maven reactor module resolved locally within the multi-module build).

Dockerfile lines 32-61: COPY . . followed by mvn clean install builds the Maven project from the repository root; the produced artifact is openmrs.war (from webapp/pom.xml finalName=openmrs), which is deployed in the Tomcat runtime stage.
docker-compose.yml: the 'api' service declares depends_on: db, establishing a startup dependency on the MariaDB service.
api/pom.xml runtime dependencies on mysql-connector-j (line 213) and mariadb-java-client (line 218).

components.why: Root pom.xml declares 8 child modules (bom, tools, test, api, web, webapp, liquibase, test-suite); only api and webapp have oracle pom.xml files, so 6 modules are unlabeled. The root component openmrs is complete from pom.xml.

deployables.why: The Dockerfile and docker-compose.yml are fully covered by oracle files, yielding the container_build and two Compose services. Additional Compose override files (docker-compose.override.yml) and grafana/elasticsearch variants are out of oracle scope.

interfaces.why: EXPOSE 8080 in Dockerfile and ports 8080:8080 in docker-compose.yml are labeled. The docker-compose.override.yml adds port 3306 for the db service, but that file is not in oracle scope.

capabilities.why: MySQL, PostgreSQL, and Elasticsearch capabilities are labeled from api/pom.xml runtime dependencies. The full dependency list (Hibernate ORM, Spring Security, Lucene, etc.) was not exhaustively mapped to capabilities; only those with clear catalog matches are labeled.

edges.why: member_of and depends_on_local edges for oracle-scope components are labeled; 6 unlabeled modules prevent complete workspace membership coverage. The Compose depends_on and Dockerfile builds edges are labeled. No runs edge is labeled because the Compose api service image name (openmrs/openmrs-core) does not directly match a component name.

notes: webapp/pom.xml finalName uses the Maven property ${webapp.name}, which is defined in webapp/pom.xml line 207 as 'openmrs'; the resolved WAR artifact name is openmrs.war.

The mariadb-java-client dependency is labeled under datastore:mysql because MariaDB uses the MySQL wire protocol and is used as a MySQL-compatible datastore in OpenMRS deployments; the catalog does not have a separate datastore:mariadb entry.
api/pom.xml declares both MySQL and PostgreSQL JDBC drivers as runtime dependencies, reflecting OpenMRS's support for multiple relational databases selectable by configuration.

The Dockerfile's dev stage (line 64: FROM maven:3.9 AS dev) and runtime stage (line 125: FROM tomcat:11) both declare EXPOSE 8080; only the runtime stage port is labeled as the primary interface since it is the production deployable.
Six Maven modules (bom, tools, test, web, liquibase, test-suite) are listed in root pom.xml but their pom.xml files are not oracle files; they are unlabeled components.
